home.paragraph1: Everything that enters our eyes eventually reaches the depths of the soul, quietly shaping the world we see.
home.paragraph2: The words we've read, the images we've watched, the moments that once moved us — in the end, they all become part of who we are.
home.roomHint: Books, films, series and anime can all live together here. No sorting required — just keep the stories you love.

doors.title: Which door will you open?
doors.lead: At the top of the spiral stairs are two doors. Behind both are the same works — just arranged differently.
doors.tidyDescription: Everything shelved by kind and ordered by title. For those who like to find things at a glance.
doors.artisticDescription: No sorting, no grouping — whatever you added last sits up front. Like books set down after a long day.
doors.switchLater: You can switch doors any time — nothing in your room will be lost.
doors.tidyBannerAlt: A pixel bookcase with three shelves of books standing neatly in color order.
doors.artisticBannerAlt: A moonlit study: a warm lamp over a reader and a cat on the sofa, surrounded by stacks of books, plants and crystals.
